Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

DietView 0.2.0

First CRAN submission.

Reproducibility and review

  • New dv_script() writes a plain R script that rebuilds a view (predator, currency, reporting resolution, covariate panels, rank and frequency of occurrence tables, digestion diagnostic) with exported functions only, from a saved dietview_prep. Its header records the package and R versions, the date, the taxonomy source and the column specification.
  • run_dietview() gains a reporting-resolution control with the full hierarchy and the three threshold aggregations of dv_aggregate_threshold() (pooled, pooled cross-predator, per predator); tabs for the frequency of occurrence and the digestion diagnostic; and a “Reproduce” tab that shows the dv_script() of the current view and downloads the script, the prepared data and the current tables.
  • New dv_lineage_check() flags, offline, spelling variants of one taxon under the same parent, labels placed under more than one parent and binomials whose genus differs from the genus column, all of which split one taxon into several nodes. On ices_lineage it flags spelling variants kept from unaccepted AphiaIDs in the stomachr lookup (e.g. “Trisopterus esmarki” next to “Trisopterus esmarkii”).

Example data

  • Three datasets of real, public stomach-content data, from the ICES Stomach Content Database (ICES, Copenhagen), as extracted in the R package stomachr (Lindmark 2026); see ?ices_diet:
    • ices_diet: 9,639 prey records from 4,231 stomachs of 22 fish species, North Sea, Skagerrak-Kattegat and Baltic Sea, 2020-2024, one row per prey record, in the format DietView expects;
    • ices_stomachs: the 8,886 sampled stomachs, one row each, the 1,197 empty ones included;
    • ices_lineage: the frozen WoRMS classification of the 461 prey keys, for an offline, reproducible dv_prepare(taxonomy = "table").
    Rows that only mark an empty stomach in the ICES export were dropped, and two unit errors in the predator variables were fixed (Belgian lengths reported in mm, Danish individual weights reported in kg). Everything else is kept as exported, including unidentified material, Nematoda (mostly parasites) and non-food items, so the data show what real surveys look like; the analyst decides what to drop. The digestion labels are inferred from the older ICES format.
  • The examples, the README, the vignettes and the website articles now use the ICES data instead of the invented example. A new article, “Case study: a complete analysis of public ICES stomach data”, works through a full analysis of them.
  • The small 24-record example (inst/extdata/dietview_example.csv and its lineage table) is kept for the tests and for quick checks of the mechanics.
  • dv_validate() gains an example.

Bug fixes

  • dv_prepare(taxonomy = "worms") no longer stops with “arguments imply differing number of rows” when some records have no AphiaID (as in the bundled example). Each record is now keyed by its AphiaID, or by its own prey name when it has none, so records without an AphiaID no longer share one lineage, and the provenance log counts every record once. One AphiaID recorded under several spellings no longer errors; the log lists the names seen under each key (names_seen).
  • Failed WoRMS lookups are no longer cached; empty lineages cached by 0.1.0 are discarded. A prey that was matched but got no classification (network or server error, unknown AphiaID) is flagged with lineage_ok = FALSE, reported by a warning and by dv_taxonomy_report(), and retried on the next run. The cache is saved even when a run is interrupted.
  • Known AphiaIDs are now checked against WoRMS: unaccepted AphiaIDs are followed to their accepted one (match_type = "id_synonym"), the stored prey name is compared with the WoRMS name (name_check), and an AphiaID whose record cannot be read is marked "id_unchecked".
  • Fuzzy name matching now uses WoRMS TAXAMATCH (worrms::wm_records_taxamatch()), which tolerates misspellings, instead of a prefix (LIKE) search. Names with several accepted WoRMS records are flagged (homonym), and the number of records WoRMS returned is logged (n_candidates).
  • The exact WoRMS name search no longer passes a fuzzy argument that current worrms (0.4.x) does not have and handed to the HTTP client, which made every exact name lookup fail.
  • dv_prepare(taxonomy = "table") now stops on duplicated keys in the lineage table, warns about prey keys absent from it, and no longer lets a record without a key inherit the lineage of a lineage row without a key.
  • dv_aggregate_threshold() now guarantees that every reported category is found in at least threshold stomachs: a residual category below the threshold moves up one more rank. Residuals of a node that also has retained descendants are labelled "<taxon> (other)", and the default other_label is now "other (below threshold)".
  • dv_validate(strict_covariates = FALSE) now really drops the missing covariates: the corrected spec is returned as the dv_spec attribute, and dv_prepare() gains strict_covariates and uses it.
  • dv_prey_accumulation(seed = ) no longer changes the user’s random stream.
  • run_dietview() no longer assumes a “class” rank for its default table.
  • dv_build_html() writes titles containing quotes or apostrophes correctly.
  • A weight or count column declared in the spec but absent from the data no longer makes dv_tree(), dv_sunburst(), dv_build_html(), run_dietview() and dv_digestion_diagnostic() fail with “replacement has 0 rows”: dv_validate() drops it from the spec with a warning, and dv_build_tree() treats an absent weight column as no weight (with a warning) and stops with a clear message on an absent count column.
  • Weight and count columns stored as factors are now read by their values, not by their level codes, in dv_build_tree(), dv_summary(), dv_matrix() and dv_digestion_diagnostic().
  • The WoRMS name cache now keeps marine_only = TRUE and marine_only = FALSE results apart; before, an answer cached under one setting was reused under the other.
  • A WoRMS name lookup that fails (timeout, server error) is no longer logged as a genuine non-match: it is flagged with lineage_ok = FALSE, reported by a warning and by dv_taxonomy_report(), not cached, and retried on the next run. A “no match” answer from WoRMS (HTTP 204) is still "unresolved".
  • dv_aggregate_threshold():
    • a rank missing in the middle of a lineage (e.g. Priapulida, which have no class) no longer stops the record from settling at a finer rank; a record that moves up skips the empty rank;
    • with scope = "per_predator", a category is labelled "<taxon> (other)" only when the same predator kept deeper categories under it;
    • threshold = NA gives a clear error.
  • dv_digestion_diagnostic() stops with a clear message when by is not a column of the data.
  • dv_size_bins() closes the outer edge (include.lowest = TRUE): a length equal to the last break is now in the last bin, labelled [a, b], instead of becoming NA.
  • dv_build_html(): predator tabs get unique ids, so predators whose names differ only by punctuation (e.g. “A-b” and “A b”) no longer open the same tab. Records with no predator trigger a warning (they appear only in the Global view).
  • A | inside a taxon label no longer breaks the node ids of dv_build_tree() (it is escaped in the id; the label is unchanged). dv_palette_tree() takes node depth from the id and assigns hues in sorted id order, so its colors no longer depend on the row order of the tree.
  • dv_taxonomy_worms() returns an empty result for an empty keys table instead of failing.

WoRMS cache

  • The cache is now managed: entries older than cache_max_age days, and the undated entries of 0.1.0, are removed from the file whenever it is read, so it no longer grows without bound. An unreadable cache file is ignored with a warning and rebuilt instead of stopping the run. The file is written through a temporary file (never left truncated) and only when something changed.
  • New dv_cache_clear() deletes the cache file, and the cache folder if nothing else is left in it.

Changes in behavior

  • One definition of the record currency everywhere: dv_build_html() and run_dietview() now count prey records by default, even when the spec declares count, and gain currency = c("records", "numbers"). New dv_tree(prep, currency) builds the tree from a prepared dataset the same way. The numbers currency warns that records without a count (usually unidentified material) contribute 0.
  • dv_validate() now checks prey keys (AphiaIDs must be positive whole numbers; records with no usable key are reported), weights (negative weights are an error, non-numeric ones a warning), the number of digestion levels, and stomach IDs shared between predators. It prints a one-line summary of the sample (records, stomachs, predators, single-record stomachs, missing weights) and returns the counts as the dv_report attribute; quiet = TRUE silences the messages. A missing weight column is now a message, not a warning.
  • dv_prepare() stores taxonomy_source, and its print method shows the number of stomachs and the taxonomy source. The WoRMS log records the retrieval time and the worrms version (attributes retrieved, worrms_version) and the date each lineage was fetched (retrieved column).
  • WoRMS cache entries now carry a date; entries older than cache_max_age days (new argument of dv_taxonomy_worms() and dv_prepare(), default 180) are fetched again. Undated entries written by 0.1.0 are fetched again once.
  • dv_taxonomy_report(which = "review") also lists id_synonym, id_unchecked, name disagreements, possible homonyms and failed classifications.
  • dv_build_html() has no default output any more, and defaults to no network access and an image folder in tempdir(), so a default call touches neither the network nor the working directory. dv_species_card_assets() has the same new defaults.
  • Predator photos can now come from iNaturalist: photo_source = "inaturalist" in dv_species_card_assets(), dv_build_html() and dv_deploy(). Only photos whose license is in licenses are used (default CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA; “all rights reserved” photos never), and only for a taxon whose name matches the query. photo_source = "wikipedia" keeps the Wikipedia / Wikimedia Commons lookup, which now uses only Commons files with a known license. use_wiki is deprecated (TRUE means "wikipedia", FALSE means "none"). Several sources can be given, tried in order, e.g. photo_source = c("inaturalist", "wikipedia"); each request times out after getOption("DietView.timeout", 15) seconds, and the result includes the image file (path), so other tools (such as a web export) can reuse it.
  • Every card photo carries its author and license: dv_species_card_assets() returns credit, author, license, source and url, and the dashboard shows the credit under the photo, linked to the photo’s page. The Wikipedia text used as a description is credited too (desc_credit). Credit fields can be given for your own photos in species_info.
  • Downloaded photos are saved with a .json file holding their credit, so a cached photo keeps its author and license in later sessions (in 0.1.0 a cached photo lost its credit line).
  • Sunbursts are sized from leaf values with branchvalues = "remainder", so a parent always equals the sum of its children; every wedge has a thin gray outline so white (unidentified) wedges stay visible, and the hover text says “Not identified at this rank”. Unidentified nodes are placed last within each parent in dv_build_tree() output, which also carries a currency attribute.
  • New dv_palette_tree(): one hue per node at a chosen rank, lighter tints for its descendants, keyed by node id. dv_sunburst(colors = ) accepts colors keyed by node id or by label.
  • Display vocabulary: “Prey records (% of all records)”, “Weight (% of total weight)” and “Distinct prey items” replace “Occurrence counts”, “Occurrence %” and “Distinct diet counts” in the app and the dashboard. The mode = "occurrence" value is unchanged.
  • dv_summary() and dv_prey_accumulation() gain rank, to count taxa at one stated rank instead of the finest resolved label (which mixes ranks and inflates richness). dv_summary()’s prey_per_stomach column is renamed records_per_stomach.
  • dv_matrix() gains rank, for a sample-by-taxon matrix at a chosen rank.
  • dv_size_bins() labels follow right and use interval notation ([40, 50) rather than [40-50[); it gains labels. The example data’s size_bin column uses the new labels.
  • dv_add_period() labels name the years each period contains (2003-2007, 2008-2020 rather than 2003-2007, 2007-2020).
  • dv_threshold_sweep() reports pct_coarser (share of records whose category is coarser than the finest rank) instead of the constant n_records.

Documentation and metadata

  • New title: “Interactive, Hierarchical Visualization of Stomach-Content Data”; new Description, author name split correctly, CADI Gulf Center listed as funder, unused packages removed from Suggests; inst/CITATION and CITATION.cff updated.
  • “Taxonomically complete” replaced by “hierarchical” throughout.
  • The data dictionary states that the example data are invented, defines the weight and digestion scale, and requires stomach IDs to be unique across the whole table.
  • New tests cover the tree invariants, frequency of occurrence, the digestion diagnostic, threshold aggregation, the matrix, validation, the lineage-table join, covariate labels and the WoRMS path (with mocked worrms calls), and every exported function now has a direct test. Tests that use withr skip when it is not installed; testthat (>= 3.1.7) and dplyr (>= 1.0.0) are now required.
  • Internal notes (CRAN_SUBMISSION.md, DEPLOYMENT.md) moved to dev/ and no longer published on the website.

DietView 0.1.0

First release.

Core pipeline

  • dv_spec(), dv_validate(), dv_prepare() — column contract, validation, and taxonomy resolution against WoRMS or a supplied lineage, with a provenance log.
  • dv_build_tree(), dv_rank_table() — within-rank importance in occurrence and weight, with unidentified prey kept explicit.
  • dv_sunburst(), dv_palette() — hierarchical sunbursts with a shared palette and the explicit-NA category in white.
  • dv_add_period(), dv_size_bins() — covariate helpers.
  • dv_digestion_diagnostic() — the identification-bias diagnostic.
  • dv_species_card_assets(), dv_build_html(), dv_deploy(), run_dietview() — species cards, a self-contained dashboard, deployment, and the Shiny explorer.

Exploration & aggregation

  • dv_summary() — sample overview by predator and covariate.
  • dv_prey_accumulation() — cumulative prey curve for sample sufficiency.
  • dv_fo_table() — classical per-rank frequency of occurrence (percent-F), the nested-hierarchy layout; distinct from the additive pct_occ.
  • dv_aggregate_threshold(), dv_threshold_sweep() — resolution-robust aggregation: collapse prey below a stomach-frequency threshold upward through the hierarchy (pooled, cross-predator, and per-predator architectures).
  • dv_matrix() — sampling-unit by prey-category matrix for downstream multivariate analysis.
